headlines.title: Trump rebukes Netanyahu for second straight day ahead of White House talks
headlines.snippet: Trump rebuked Netanyahu for the second consecutive day ahead of their White House talks. The reason for the rebuke was not specified.

headlines.title: Trump agrees to grant Ukraine Patriot missile system licences: Zelenskyy
headlines.snippet: Zelenskyy stated that Trump agreed to grant Ukraine licenses for the Patriot missile system. This agreement pertains to military aid.
